name: dotlife
description: Local-first PWA: a span of time as a dot grid, and how much of it is left.

scripts.test:tz: for tz in America/New_York Europe/London Asia/Kolkata Australia/Lord_Howe Pacific/Auckland; do TZ=$tz vitest run || exit 1; done
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name dotlife
